title: README mascot matches the site hero on GitHub

demand.statement: GitHub readers must see the README mascot the same way on dark and light themes. The image must be a static frame of the docs site hero, with resting glow, a dark background, and rounded corners. Out of scope: retornatus-mascot-neon.webp, retornatus-mascot-square.webp, docs/index.html, and site.css.
